laws.rule: Đerdap National Park: protected-area entry RSD 290 per person (RSD 170 each for groups over 10), paid at outlets at the start of the busiest trails (Kovilovo, Ploče). Visitor centres (Donji Milanovac, Tekija) RSD 100, under 18 RSD 50. (No RBA rate for RSD; at the National Bank of Serbia rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 73.8203 RSD: RSD 290 ≈ A$3.93; RSD 170 ≈ A$2.30; RSD 100 ≈ A$1.35; RSD 50 ≈ A$0.68)
